summary: 20 public goods game benchmark experiments sampled across 14 design parameters; forecasters predict treatment-condition group efficiency from the design description and observed control-condition outcome.
2,011 individual papers and 717 curated multi-paper collections are converted into prediction-focused reports for prompting.

8 LLMs generate predictions under no augmentation or with benchmark-paper, individual-paper, or collection-report augmentation; performance is evaluated by correlation with observed treatment outcomes.
